scope: Verification corrections for the bounded Q0 prototype and native persistence/transaction service; later product and vendor obligations remain unchanged

findings.problem: Restart prefix comparisons could accept truncated output or mismatched time/control/algebraic/energy/Jacobian state
findings.correction: Complete checkpoint/resume sample and event coverage with typed finite state and SI-specific criteria

findings.problem: Steady assessment trusted a reported negative or nonfinite norm
findings.correction: Finite nonnegative norm plus independent heat balances

findings.problem: Deep Windows checkouts exceeded native linker path limits
findings.correction: Short checkout-scoped native dependency and prototype build cache; sealed evidence stays with each attempt

findings.problem: Create-only authority accepted deletions and batches
findings.correction: Exactly one new insertion with no deletions or replacement

findings.problem: Re-export rehashed corrupt originals and dropped model graph or audit identity metadata
findings.correction: Original manifest pins verified before mutations and export; preserve dependency edges paths audit IDs and collision-free generated IDs

findings.problem: Result data dependencies could be absent or disagree with actual HDF5 metadata
findings.correction: Closed typed references plus matching role semantic hash node order time count quantities and scalar attributes

findings.problem: A delayed save captured an old snapshot before the destination lock
findings.correction: Select snapshots after acquiring the destination lock

findings.problem: Overlapping host syncs could adopt competing bytes or collide with operational paths
findings.correction: Project and destination leases prepared-journal checks and target-alias rejection

findings.problem: Stat-then-read and direct in-memory manifests could exceed inspected byte budgets
findings.correction: Bound actual reads and enforce the same JSON budget before store creation

remaining_obligations: Production physics and general DAE/sparse graphs in their owning packages
WP-06 worker/job lifecycle and immutable result publication
WP-13/14/15 actual host workflows authorization transports and application parity
All vendor qualification and complete release/redistribution obligations
evidence_policy: Synthetic public regressions bounded verdicts and exact source/report hashes only. Original baseline plus sealed failed and successful attempts remain preserved. Raw models generated packages arrays databases host documents compiler/crash logs and cache paths remain local. Exact staged/history/identity and report/prose scans precede publication.
